dimensions.label: 規格合規
dimensions.question: Is this exactly what was asked — no more, no less? Compare the change to the spec line by line and name anything added or missing.

dimensions.label: 缺陷
dimensions.question: Where is it wrong? Give concrete inputs and the wrong result each one produces, not a general worry.

dimensions.label: 風險與可逆性
dimensions.question: What does it make hard to undo, and what happens if it is wrong in production?

dimensions.label: 慣例與簡潔
dimensions.question: Does it read like the surrounding code — naming, comment density, idiom? Is any of it unnecessary?

dimensions.label: 資訊安全
dimensions.question: Look for injection, secret exposure, privilege escalation, red-line bypass and unsafe defaults.

dimensions.label: UX/UI
dimensions.question: Are the console, CLI and messages usable and clear, and is anything inaccessible to a user who cannot see colour or read the language?

dimensions.label: CI/測試
dimensions.question: Do the tests fail when the change is broken? Check the test matrix and any source of flakiness.

dimensions.label: 模組化/架構
dimensions.question: Are the boundaries and coupling sound, and is every new piece wired into something that calls it (KN-8)?

dimensions.label: 隱私/資料外流
dimensions.question: What leaves the machine, to whom (the models' `reach`), and is that disclosed to the user?

dimensions.label: 效能/成本
dimensions.question: What are the wall-clock time and the token or quota spend, and which model calls are avoidable?

dimensions.label: 跨平台相容性
dimensions.question: Will it run on Windows and Linux and on Python 3.9–3.13 — paths, encodings, subprocess behaviour?

dimensions.label: 文件與治理一致
dimensions.question: Do README, SCHEMAS and the CHG and ACC records agree with the code, and are the ledger rules followed?

dimensions.label: 錯誤處理/可觀測性
dimensions.question: Are failures reported rather than swallowed, and do the logs say what actually happened?

dimensions.label: 相依/供應鏈
dimensions.question: Does it add dependencies, unpinned versions or external downloads?

dimensions.label: 國際化/在地化
dimensions.question: Check text encoding, mixed-language UI and any locale assumptions.
